title: Chapter 678
paragraphs: Chapter 678
Episode 173. Chasing the Sword (3)
The sword flew for a full three days and nights from him. It swept across the continent and waters relentlessly for those three days and nights.
The speed was so fast that the group only barely followed its tail for the first ten minutes or so, after that they had to rely on the anti-air network of their allies and their testimonies.
"Damn it, where the hell is the destination?"
Quicantel spoke with a voice full of anger.
Due to an unexpected emergency situation that no one could have predicted, she was flying around the world without sleeping for three days.
Of course, for a dragon, three days of continuous flight isn't a big deal, but flying at full speed almost every moment was exhausting.
Who would have thought the day would come when she would be in a chase with the 'sword'.
"My sword… Can we... find my sword…?”

Like all warriors, Hedo cherished his longsword. There is no one in the current era who could produce such a masterpiece, and it was also a reward he earned after battling the monster of the Black Sea in his youth, which added to his attachment.
So it's no wonder Hedo is upset as the sword has been flapping in the sky for three days already.
With a pale complexion that didn't suit his muscular figure, Sandra kept giving him bland and insincere words of consolation.

"It's unfortunate that the sword has run away, but thanks to that, we're having an air date with our selves for two days, Hedo. Let's think positively. It'll be a memory you won't forget for a lifetime!"
Those who were riding on Quicantel's back admired Hedo, who didn't react to Sandra's words at all.
"We're beginning to see the outline of our destination, Quicantel. Please bear with us a little longer. Please be patient, Guardian of the Tower. I have nothing to say but I'm sorry."
Until the day before, Hedo's sword was just running wild in all directions like a mad dog.
It went north and then turned south again, it went east and then turned west, driving those who were chasing it crazy.
It even felt like the sword was deliberately teasing people.
Of course, not only the Sword's Garden and Zipple, Kinzelo during those two days.
"Umi... What is that?"
"Is that a distant meteor falling?"
"Oh my, isn't that the remnant of Chaos!? We should run!"
The fishermen in various seas.
"Isn't that, by any chance, a remnant of Chaos!?"
"The Silver Dragon Quicantel is chasing after it!"
"Wow, I can see the 12th generation and the Vamel Alliance! Are they suppressing the Chaos?"
"True Runcandel!"
"A toast for His Majesty the Sub-King and True Runcandel!"
People in all kinds of cities living peaceful lives under the protection of the Vamel Alliance, Dante, and other large forces also got to know.
In other words, more people knew about this situation than those who didn't over the course of three days. It became impossible to secretly enter the sixth tomb of Temar.
"Sorry? If you apologize, does the veil return to me?"
"I will take responsibility in some way later and compensate for this damage."
"We've already reached a point of no return...! The lady and I have already been exposed on the ships of our clan!"

Indeed, during the process of tracking the sword, the party had already encountered the pursuit forces of other factions several times. It meant that the chaotic dragon of Runcandel, the Black Line, the ships of Kinzelo and Zipple, and the dragons had all seen Sandra and Hedo.
-Lord Hedo...!?
-Isn't that Miss Sandra next to him? Why are the two who went on vacation with the 12th...?
-Looking at it, that flying object is very similar to Lord Hedo's sword.

In particular, Hedo's muscular giant was so distinctive that anyone who saw him once could recognize him from afar, so there was no way to pretend otherwise. Not that he didn't pretend, but it was useless.
Therefore, Hedo was already overwhelmed by the task of going back and explaining.
Now the Vamel Alliance and Zipple are temporarily allied, and Hedo is in a very special position within the clan.
The problem was that they did not report in advance.
"Why is that a problem? As soon as Hedo goes out with me, it's obvious that I'm going on a date with Jin."
"It's a problem because we didn't report in advance that the 12th Flagbearer is helping to check the sword, miss..."
"Guardian of the Tower, why didn't you report?"
He didn't want to get tired.
Hedo didn't even tell the clan about the fact that Bale played a crucial role when they entered the fifth tomb last time.
Of course, the ancestors had already confirmed it, but if Zipple suspected any connection between him and the old Runcandel, he would have had to go through several annoying procedures.
Besides, he was hiding the fact that he escaped earlier than other Zifls thanks to Jin when he escaped from the snowfield, so it wasn't just an uncomfortable situation for Hedo.
"I didn't know things would get so tangled."
Although he had been angry with Jin all along, Hedo actually thought that all this was due to his own negligence.
'I've been too lax due to the consideration of the clan leader and the leaders all along. I've been too careless.'
He was not very worried about being blamed for this in the future.
The problem was Sandra.
-Are you protecting Sandra Zipple?
-Yes.
-I don't understand. The protection you speak of, does it mean tolerating all experiments up to a certain level targeting Sandra?
The conversation with Jin before the sword went berserk.
As it was said, so far, Sandra was able to avoid 'quite fatal' levels of experiments all thanks to Hedo's presence.
The Zipple knew exactly what Hedo wanted. What he desired wasn't greater power, opportunities to fight stronger opponents, or rising to the position of being a sole controller and supreme being.
Only Sandra's survival.
For that reason, Zipple often turned a blind eye even when Hedo occasionally violated the rules. Even if he was involved in any uncomfortable situation, they didn't investigate it seriously.
After all, the results of everything Hedo did always returned as a benefit for Sandra and, hence, for Zipple.
But this case is different.
If Jin becomes stronger again due to Hedo's sword, or if there are problems with the historical manipulation of old Runcandel, Hedo would have nothing to say even if Zipple threatened Sandra.
'If a formal investigation begins, it may be revealed that I killed the ghosts in the Sota desert last time, and let the 12th party be released by pretending to be harmed by Aynas....'
Hedo was hoping for a clean ending to this situation.
But his hopes could not be fulfilled.
"[Cough, gasp. The sword... it's stopped!]"
Quicantel said, gasping for breath.
In the middle of the sea, known as the sea of swords by Hupfester and the sea of magic by the Lutero Magic Federation.
"Quicantel was passing through here on the first day of his flight, and now this sea is the destination?"
"It may have just stopped briefly... Fortunately, it seems that's not the case."
In response to Jin, the sword stopped for the first time since it began to move.
The blade, slowly rotating like the hands of a clock, soon pointed to the sea.
As if to pierce it.
Fffwing, Zzzhooosh-!
With an incredible boom as the air was torn and burst, the sword struck the middle of the sea.
Then, an astonishing thing happened.
Coooooo…!
Literally, the sea flipped over.
As if a giant had balled up a few mountains and hurled them like a stone, an unspeakably massive wave rose, and the water that had sprung up almost touched the clouds.
Quicantel and his companions spread a protective shield to repel the seawater. A heavy sensation, as much as a sincere attack from a superhuman, was transmitted from the water.
Perhaps the world shook for a moment. And the power that Hedo's sword unleashed was all the aura that Jin had absorbed three days ago.
Normally, it takes a long time for such a commotion to subside.
The sea would continuously be in turmoil for a while, pushing tsunamis even to the land, and there would be nothing people could do until the disaster ended.
However, the incident caused by the sword was not a disaster, but a divine discovery.
The aura pouring out from the sword moved on its own, touching the bare skin of the sea below.
Like carefully touching a precious item forgotten and covered in dust, the aura continued to seep into the seabed.
"Lord, the aura is pulling up something like a building from the bottom!"
Valkas said, his eyes wide open.
His companions were all witnessing the same scene. Like a legend often heard in any region, a hidden civilization under the sea was being revealed.
Even Hedo, who had been gripped by worry until a moment ago, was momentarily entranced, watching the scene.
Those observing were all in awe.
Even when the past Omango split the sea and pulled out a huge clam, it was shocking, but it felt trivial compared to the scene now in front of the group.
"Wow... Honey, is that your ancestor's sixth tomb?"
Jin tried to respond but met Valeria's eyes.
"Didn't you say it was a subspace within the sword?"
In front of Valeria, a small blue window of record magic was open.
"<Jin Runcandel finally opens the …… subspace contained in the sword.>"
The record window was showing such a phrase.
"... Yes, the subspace existing within the sword has been opened. It seems that we didn't enter into the sword through the portal, but the subspace inherent in the sword is leaking out."
Then, the sword had been flying to find a location where it could pull out that space.
"But this doesn't seem to be Solderet's subspace. If it was a subspace he created, the name would have been specified exactly."
Speaking as if perplexed, Valeria let out a sigh. A more important problem than whose subspace it was, was now at hand.
"We found it!"
"[The flying object has stopped! Cease fire, and check that thing and the rebels first!]"
It was what Zipple and the pursuit team from the Sword Garden said.
Like the Vamel Alliance, they had been chasing the sword until now, and in the process, their routes overlapped, and they were in battle.
"Your Highness, we found it. The chief is in critical condition, so please do not use any power!"
The same went for Kinzelo.
Once again, three huge forces gathered in the middle of the sea.
Jin and his party couldn't hear their voices because of the distance, but they knew that they were nearby.
Jin was still looking at the seawater mixed with aura pouring out like a waterfall around him.
Aura had spread out to the distant area where each force's ships and dragons were floating.
All areas touched by the aura are the subspace of the sword.
That means, all those who were pursuing the sword have already entered the subspace... The fight inside the tomb was inevitable.
